acceptanceCriteria: static finding with line and nearest stubbed value, fixture-backed
run receipt with 5xx plus unstubbed outbound call classifies ENV-UNSTUBBED-CALL naming the call
missing stub table or server log abstains with a named reason
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1192. Static: given the environment stub table (request matchers the mock layer answers), report test inputs reaching a stubbed integration with values no matcher covers, as UNSTUBBED-OUTBOUND-INPUT with the test line and nearest stubbed value. Run-time: when a run receipt records a 5xx whose server log shows an outbound call to an unstubbed host/path, classify ENV-UNSTUBBED-CALL (not product/test failure) and name the call. Absent stub table or server log abstains.
title: GH #1192: UNSTUBBED-OUTBOUND-INPUT static finding and ENV-UNSTUBBED-CALL run classification
